name: Andi Lin
title: Andi Lin — Photography
description: Photographs by Andi Lin. Observations of people, architecture, and the everyday life of places.
biography: Youyuan (Andi) Lin is an architecture student and photographer whose work explores the relationships between people, built environments, and everyday life. Her photographs attend to the gestures, reflections, and passing encounters that give places meaning.

An architectural education informs her sensitivity to space, material, and the stories held in ordinary surroundings. Moving between the scale of a city and the intimacy of a small detail, she looks at how human presence animates the spaces we inhabit.
She holds a Bachelor of Science in Architecture with an Environment Minor from McGill University and is pursuing a Master of Science in Architecture, Urbanism and Building Sciences at TU Delft.
